plants.name: Prunus mume
plants.description: Bare, dark branches burst into small, spicy-sweet blossoms that open before any leaves appear. The petals look like pink and white confetti against late-winter skies.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late January through March, with peak bloom in February and early March in many areas
plants.location: Japan and elsewhere in East Asia, including China and Korea
plants.funFact: Ume blooms weeks before cherry trees do, so it is traditionally seen as the first herald of spring in Japan. Its sour fruit is pickled into umeboshi and steeped into plum wine.

plants.name: Cyclamen persicum
plants.description: Swept-back petals give each flower a look of tiny butterflies hovering above marbled, silver-patterned heart-shaped leaves. In the wild, drifts of them light up shady, rocky hillsides.
plants.bloomingSeason: Winter to spring, with wild populations flowering through February and March
plants.location: Rocky hillsides and woodland of the eastern Mediterranean, including Israel, Lebanon, Turkey and Greece
plants.funFact: Once the flowers fade, the stems coil like springs and pull the seed pods down toward the soil. This helps plant the next generation close to the parent. The wild species is also the ancestor of the cyclamens sold as houseplants.

plants.name: Amaryllis belladonna
plants.commonName: March lily, belladonna lily, naked lady
plants.description: Leafless stalks rise from dry late-summer ground, each topped with a cluster of fragrant, trumpet-shaped blooms in rosy pink. The flowers appear before the leaves, which is why they are called naked ladies.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late summer to autumn in the Southern Hemisphere, with flowering in February and March
plants.funFact: The common name 'March lily' comes from the time of year the flowers appear in South Africa. The leaves come up later, after the flowers have finished.
